title.en: Asking About a Room for Rent

subtitle: 看到租屋廣告，寫信問房東問題並約看房
task: You saw an advertisement for a room near your university. Write a short email to the landlord, Mr. Brown. Ask two or three questions about the room and ask to see it.
taskZh: 你看到學校附近的租屋廣告。寫一封簡短的 email 給房東 Brown 先生，問兩、三個關於房間的問題，並約時間看房。
focus: 問題清楚，一句問一件事
說明自己的身分與入住時間
有禮貌地提出看房請求

en: I saw your advertisement for the room on Oak Street, and I am very interested in it. I am a student from Taiwan, and I will study at the university from September.
I have a few questions. Is the rent $750 a month, including water and electricity? Is the room furnished? How long is the lease?
If the room is still available, could I come to see it this weekend? I am free on Saturday morning.
zh: 我看到您在 Oak Street 出租房間的廣告，非常有興趣。我是台灣來的學生，九月起會在這裡的大學念書。
我有幾個問題。每月房租 750 美元有包含水電嗎？房間有附家具嗎？租約是多久？
如果房間還沒租出去，我這個週末可以去看房嗎？我星期六早上有空。
